findings.source_issue: The example calls Box A -> Box Diamond A axiom 5, but the edition defines 5 as Diamond A -> Box Diamond A; its old tableau proves the former, not the claimed latter.
findings.minimal_treatment: Keep the intended S5 proves axiom 5 claim; change the explanatory formula and tableau to the actual axiom 5 by using the true-Diamond witness at new 1.2 and closing with false Diamond there; disclose adjacent to the example.
